quantize_model_int4wo: quantize a PyTorch model using int4 weight-only quantization with a specified group size
quantize_model_int8wo: quantize a PyTorch model using int8 weight-only quantization
quantize_model_fp8wo: quantize a PyTorch model using fp8 weight-only quantization
quantize_model_fp8dq: quantize a PyTorch model using fp8 dynamic activation and weight quantization with per-row or per-tensor granularity
filter_proj_layers: filter model layers by fully qualified name to target projection layers for quantization
